issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation attributes 'đầy ân điển và lẽ thật' (full of grace and truth) to the Word/Incarnation ('Ngôi Lời') in the first clause. In the Greek text, 'πληρης χαριτος και αληθειας' modifies 'δοξαν' (glory), describing the glory of the only begotten Son.

The Vietnamese translation renders 'δοξαν ως μονογενους' as 'vinh hiển của Con một', which implies the glory *of* the Only Begotten. The Greek 'δοξαν ως μονογενους' more accurately means 'glory as [the] only-begotten' (the nature of the glory being that of the only-begotten).
